text:
nora: hitting a bunch of onboarding fails after the exports cleanup in @sdk. quickstart (TS + JS) both error out depending on import style.

diego: saw it too. Node CJS sample fails with `Error: Cannot find module 'sdk'` when using require, and ESM worker blows up with 'does not provide an export named default'.

nora: minimal repro in sample-app/node/index.js: `const sdk = require('sdk')` -> fails. sample-app/edge/entry.mjs: `import sdk from 'sdk'` -> TypeError about missing default.

build-bot: dependency update sdk@2.3.1 altered package.json exports (removed legacy main/module fallback). CI failing on samples. https://ci.internal/infra/12345

kevin: it looks like the new exports map points to the edge-only ESM build. That breaks older consumers and our samples. We need a backwards-compatible conditional exports map or a thin CJS proxy.

olivia: for typings, consumers doing `import { Auth } from 'sdk/auth'` are losing types. Our `types` points to top-level but subpath imports don't resolve. We should expose common subpaths explicitly under exports.

diego: suggestion: conditional exports like:
```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "node": { "require": "./dist/node/cjs/index.cjs", "import": "./dist/node/esm/index.mjs" },
    "default": "./dist/edge/esm/index.mjs"
  },
  "./auth": "./dist/auth/index.mjs"
}
```

nora: fine plan. short-term: patch quickstarts to use explicit `import sdk from 'sdk/edge'` or `require('sdk/node')` so new users can boot immediately. Long-term: restore a temporary fallback on main and ship the conditional exports with typings.

kevin: I'll prepare a rollback PR to unblock onboarding, then a follow-up that adds subpath typings and a publish filter so we don't bloat installs. Also adding CI matrix to run samples on node:cjs, node:esm, and cloudflare on PRs touching package.json/exports.

build-bot: build alerts quieted for rollback branch. rerunning sample E2E once PR merges.

olivia: filing a tracking issue for typings/subpath exports: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1250. Also adding a small script to verify `require()` vs `import` resolution during publish.

nora: thanks. please post PR numbers here. once rollback lands I'll re-run onboarding smoke and confirm auth/retry tests too (they were flaky if the wrong bundle landed). :thumbsup:
